follow-up time: Duration of the Hajj pilgrimage (August-October 2015 and 2016 and July-September 2017)
finding: Pregnant Hajj pilgrims experienced a high rate of abortion (28.07%) and respiratory tract infections (51.75%), highlighting the risks associated with pregnancy during this pilgrimage.
mod_finding: There were 20 vaginal deliveries (17.54%) and two Caesarean sections (1.75%).
